translations.Somebody else has this document open. Wh: Somebody else has this document open. What you type is shown to them as you type it.
translations.A category is a folder, so everything fi: A category is a folder, so everything filed in it is shared, and so is everything filed in it afterwards. Somebody who may write in it can add documents to it as well.
translations.Somebody else has written over {n} parag: Somebody else has written over {n} paragraphs you had just written. Ctrl+Z brings yours back.

translations.The numbers are counted by the file itse: The numbers are counted by the file itself, so adding a section renumbers everything after it. They are not part of the text and do not appear in a contents list.
translations.How it sits on the page: How it sits on the page
translations.The page colour, the picture and the fra: The page colour, the picture and the frame are written into the file, and the file asks the browser to print them: in the print dialogue, background graphics must be left on. The frame is drawn on every page.
translations.These are the document’s own defaults —: These are the document’s own defaults — what text is set in when nothing else has been said about it. To change one passage, use the size and typeface boxes in the toolbar; they act on what is selected, or on the paragraph the cursor is in.
Any family on Google Fonts can be used. The document carries its typefaces with it, so the file looks the same on a machine where they are not installed.
translations.Page numbers and running headers come fr: Page numbers and running headers come from your browser print dialogue: browsers do not yet support headers inside the page rule. Everything else here is written into the file.
translations.Use as default for new documents: Use as default for new documents
translations.This could not be turned into a document: This could not be turned into a document
translations.These arrived with what you pasted. A do: These arrived with what you pasted. A document is made of writing and of objects that can be printed, and none of these is either: a browser draws them by fetching or running something else.
translations.They can be put in as inline frames. Rea: They can be put in as inline frames. Read this first:
translations.It is fetched from that address every ti: It is fetched from that address every time the document is opened, so the file is no longer one file that stands on its own, and it shows nothing without a network.
translations.It may not print. A printer is given the: It may not print. A printer is given the page as it stands, and a frame that has not finished loading — or that refuses to be printed — comes out blank. The address is printed underneath it so the paper still says what was there.
translations.The site may refuse to be framed at all,: The site may refuse to be framed at all, and then the frame stays empty.
translations.MathML is drawn by the browser itself, s: MathML is drawn by the browser itself, so the formula stays text in the file — searchable, selectable and never a picture.
translations.Choosing a contact writes the address bl: Choosing a contact writes the address block at the cursor. For one letter per contact, use the merge fields below.
translations.Choosing a record writes it at the curso: Choosing a record writes it at the cursor as a two-column table, leaving out the fields it has nothing in. For one letter per record, use the merge fields below.
translations.{n} records will be filled into {k} fiel: {n} records will be filled into {k} fields:
translations.One document, one page per record: One document, one page per record
translations.The picture is embedded in the document: The picture is embedded in the document itself, so it travels with the file. Large photographs are scaled down on the way in.
translations.A folder in your own Files. Documents al: A folder in your own Files. Documents already saved elsewhere stay where they are.
translations.Turn an address into a link as it is typ: Turn an address into a link as it is typed
translations.Paste into a box of its own: Paste into a box of its own
translations.What is pasted arrives as an object with: What is pasted arrives as an object with a box round it, ready to be put where it belongs. Hold Shift while pasting to put it straight into the writing as plain text.
translations.Spelling is checked by the browser itsel: Spelling is checked by the browser itself, in the language it is set to. Shift+right-click reaches its suggestions.
translations.This is exactly what is stored in Files: This is exactly what is stored in Files — one file, styles included, nothing else needed to open it.
translations.These rules go into the file itself, aft: These rules go into the file itself, after the ones above, so they are the ones that win. Name the parts of the document as they are written: h1 to h6 for the headings, p for the body, ul, ol and li for lists, blockquote, table, th, td, figcaption. The page changes as you type.
None of it could be read as CSS.
translations.This changes every paragraph of that kin: This changes every paragraph of that kind at once, now and later, because it is written as a rule in the file rather than on each paragraph. Anything you have set on one paragraph by hand still wins over it.
Drag the picture to choose what shows.
translations.Nothing is cut away: the whole picture s: Nothing is cut away: the whole picture stays in the file and the frame simply shows part of it, so the crop can be changed or undone at any time.
translations.This is put on every cell the selection: This is put on every cell the selection touches. Select across several cells first to do a block of them at once.
translations.The reading is written above the word, a: The reading is written above the word, at half its size, using the element HTML has for exactly this.
translations.A number goes in at the cursor and the n: A number goes in at the cursor and the note is added to the list at the end of the document. The numbers follow the order the notes are cited in and look after themselves. A browser cannot put a note at the foot of the page that cites it: nothing in CSS moves text from one page to another.
translations.The paragraphs you have selected are lai: The paragraphs you have selected are laid out in columns. Select a paragraph inside them and choose one column to take the columns off again.
translations.Nothing to report: everything on the pag: Nothing to report: everything on the page stands where it should.
translations.{name} is drawn across the edge of the p: {name} is drawn across the edge of the paper and would print cut in two.
translations.{n} lines of writing run under {name}, w: {n} lines of writing run under {name}, which is set to keep them clear.
translations.{name} holds more writing than it can sh: {name} holds more writing than it can show.
translations.A picture of about {n} MB is in the docu: A picture of about {n} MB is in the document. “Make the pictures lighter” will shrink it.
Page {n} has nothing written on it.
translations.These repeat in the margin of every prin: These repeat in the margin of every printed page. Anything in braces is filled in when the file is written: {title} is the title of the document, {name} its file name, {date} and {time} when it was saved. A page number cannot be among them -- a browser has no count of printed pages to give -- and comes from the print dialogue's own headers and footers instead.
translations.In the flow of the text: In the flow of the text
translations.In the flow, at the left: In the flow, at the left
translations.In the flow, at the right: In the flow, at the right
translations.A frame placed freely is measured from t: A frame placed freely is measured from the line of text it was put on, so it keeps to that page when the document is printed. The text runs underneath it rather than round it.
translations.The text runs round a wrapped frame. Mov: The text runs round a wrapped frame. Move it with the four spacings below: they are what holds it away from the words.
translations.Fill colours are printed: the file tells: Fill colours are printed: the file tells the browser to print them even when it would normally leave backgrounds out.
translations.Insert a column to the left: Insert a column to the left
translations.Insert a column to the right: Insert a column to the right
translations.“{words}” — what is set here is written: “{words}” — what is set here is written on these words alone.
translations.Start a new page before this paragraph: Start a new page before this paragraph
translations.Do not split this paragraph across pages: Do not split this paragraph across pages
translations.Never leave one line of it alone on a pa: Never leave one line of it alone on a page
translations.Empty means the paragraph inherits from: Empty means the paragraph inherits from the paper setup. These are written into the file as ordinary CSS, so a browser prints them the same way.
translations.Title: Title
translations.Built from the headings in the document,: Built from the headings in the document, as links to them. Running it again brings an existing contents list up to date.
translations.The character goes in at the caret. The: The character goes in at the caret. The dialog stays open so several can be picked.
translations.The writing on the page is brought in: h: The writing on the page is brought in: headings, paragraphs, lists, tables and pictures. Navigation, sidebars and advertising are left behind. Copying a page and pasting it here does the same thing.
translations.The words that carry the link: The words that carry the link
translations.A bare address becomes https://, and an: A bare address becomes https://, and an e-mail address becomes a mailto: link.
translations.This is what a screen reader says, and w: This is what a screen reader says, and what shows if the picture cannot be loaded. It is written into the file as the alt attribute.
translations.This document has no merge fields yet. P: This document has no merge fields yet. Put a field such as {example} into the text first.

translations.Turn on “Background graphics” in the pri: Turn on “Background graphics” in the print dialogue, or the page’s colour and frame will not be printed.
